justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/jarscan/nextinstruction/NextInstructionOperation.java, NextInstructionCount.java, and NextInstructionCountList.java plus core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/jarscan/JarScan.java. JarScan.java is the only source file that imports and instantiates NextInstructionOperation, so the target package has very low incoming coupling. Its classes depend on sibling jarscan.sequencecount types and shared model.bytecode.Opcode; SequenceCountOperation is also used directly by JarScan, and Opcode is reused across many packages in the repo, so there is no evidence the target package depends on less-stable packages than itself.
